title: Mehavocs
description: adds (toggle-able) chaotic modifiers to your player(s)!
body:
This mod adds 2 new items and 5 new game mechanics you can toggle on and off in a GUI _{opened with BackSlash}_

see the gallery for items and recipes for them

# MECHANICS
* **Rigged Blocks**: _**all**_ blocks have a 5% chance to explode when placed
* **Inexperienced Crafting**: 30% To fail at crafting, causing a small (survivable) explosion
* **Mob Reinforcements**: Mobs have a tiny chance to spawn in two additional mobs when hit (limited to zombies for now)
* **Hard Fall**: Falling from more than 20 blocks will result in small explosion which knocks away other entities (size/damage/knockback based on falling distance) ~~note: this works on all entities~~
* **Fish**: fish.

These mechanics are checked with attributes, so all players have thier own sets of mechanics based on preferences. **Wreck havoc!**
